title: split dns_enforcer.sh and give its chain code a real test
objective: Move the iptables chain machinery out of dns_enforcer.sh so both files are under 250 lines, carry the new sibling in both deploy.sh lists, and replace the dead test_dns_enforcer.sh with a suite that actually exercises the moved code.
acceptance_criteria: verify_shell_split.sh reports all 14 top-level functions moved verbatim
test_dns_iptables.sh reports 20 passed, 0 failed, and fails under each of three independent mutations
dns_iptables.sh appears in BOTH the adb_cmd push list and the adb_root cp list in deploy.sh
Sourcing dns_enforcer.sh with main() disabled resolves all seven moved functions at runtime
shellcheck is clean on every changed shell file, standing alone, with zero suppressions
check_file_length.sh --all drops from 23 over-cap files to 22, with no new file over the cap
out_of_scope: Deploying to the phone or verifying on-device behaviour — explicitly excluded by the user this session
Repairing test_dns_enforcer.sh, which is deleted rather than fixed
Any behavioural change to the chain functions themselves
